purpose: Independent practice of C4 step 1 (situation and question).
student_learning_goal: I can describe a real-life situation and ask math questions about it.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can describe a real-life situation and ask math questions about it.
header.character_watermark: Maple the Maple Tree in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Draw or write what you see in the sugar bush. Use 2-3 sentences.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. A bordered box with lines for description.

image_placeholders.description: A blank bordered box in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in, with 3 description lines beneath. Header 'My Sugar Bush:'. Small Maple tree icon in the corner of the box.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P1_BUSH_BOX: keywords (sugar, bush) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Look for trees, taps, buckets, snow, or sap detail.

parts.student_instructions: Write 3 math questions about the sugar bush. Each question should ask HOW MANY, HOW MUCH, HOW LONG, or HOW TALL.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Three numbered question lines.

image_placeholders.description: Three numbered question slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 3in. Each slot has '1.', '2.', '3.' on the left with a long question line. Header 'My Math Questions:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P2_QUESTIONS: keywords (math, questions) name what the slots ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Each question must be countable or measurable. Examples: 'How many trees?' 'How tall is each tree?' 'How long does it take to fill a bucket?'

parts.student_instructions: Pick something from YOUR day (snack, recess, bus). Draw or describe it, then write 2 math questions about it.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. A drawing or writing box plus 2 question lines.

image_placeholders.description: A blank drawing area in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in, with 2 numbered question lines beneath. Header 'My Day:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P3_MY_DAY: keywords (my, day) name what the box asks for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Two math questions must be countable or measurable about a real-life situation from the child's day.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, swap with a partner and answer one of their math questions with a guess.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 worksheet introduces C4 step 1 (situation and question). Watch for descriptive-vs-mathematical confusion. If a child writes 'What colour is the tree?' redirect to a HOW MANY frame.
